arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Himmelfarb cited Budinich v. Becton Dickinson for immediate appeal rights.
Mr. Feldman argued all damages claims must resolve before finality.
Justice Kagan questioned if listing fees in complaints changes the outcome.
Justice Breyer asked if general fee mentions in contracts affect finality.
